note: How often each kind of finding was worth an officer's look when the team read it by eye. Risk fusion v3 (fusion/calibrated.py) turns a finding into a chance: hit_rate x strength, where hit_rate = (worth + 1) / (read + 4) (a cautious prior of 1 in 4, so a finding read only a few times counts little) and strength = the finding's risk / ref_risk (1 for fixed-risk findings; a weaker flag of a graded kind counts in proportion). 'design' entries are not measurements: they write down a decision the team already made (a wait alone never reaches High; a missing field is a data gap). A code that is not listed counts at the prior (1 in 4) until it is read: proof before launch, in numbers. Officer verdicts (T070) add to worth/read; re-read the sources when the engines change.
